findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: code_gate, build_status, list_apps, dead_letters, rcs_log, notifications, notify_channel, credentials · Private data: code_gate, read_docs, submit_feedback, search_docs, list_packages, read_package, app_host, provision, provision_ephemeral, claim, deploy_source, status, describe_services, claim_domain, verify_domain, fork, rcs_commit, rcs_checkout, deploy_ref, deploy_release, rollback_release, set_secret, list_secrets, delete_secret, set_notify_channel, notify_channel, rotate_token, confirm_token, revoke_other_tokens, credentials, rcs_commit_file · Public sink: code_gate, submit_feedback, deploy_source, claim_domain, rcs_commit, deploy_ref, rcs_land, rollback_release, set_notify_channel, notify_channel, delete_notify_channel, credentials, rcs_commit_file · Destructive: validate_spec, code_gate, deploy_source, build_status, delete_repository, remove_dead_letters, test_ref, deploy_release, delete_preview, delete_secret, notifications, delete_notify_channel, remove_member.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: code_gate, build_status, list_apps, dead_letters, rcs_log, notifications, notify_channel, credentials · Private data: code_gate, read_docs, submit_feedback, search_docs, list_packages, read_package, app_host, provision, provision_ephemeral, claim, deploy_source, status, describe_services, claim_domain, verify_domain, fork, rcs_commit, rcs_checkout, deploy_ref, deploy_release, rollback_release, set_secret, list_secrets, delete_secret, set_notify_channel, notify_channel, rotate_token, confirm_token, revoke_other_tokens, credentials, rcs_commit_file · Public sink: code_gate, submit_feedback, deploy_source, claim_domain, rcs_commit, deploy_ref, rcs_land, rollback_release, set_notify_channel, notify_channel, delete_notify_channel, credentials, rcs_commit_file · Destructive: validate_spec, code_gate, deploy_source, build_status, delete_repository, remove_dead_letters, test_ref, deploy_release, delete_preview, delete_secret, notifications, delete_notify_channel, remove_member

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
